environment.description: ASP.NET Core 7 application deployed on Azure App Service (B2 tier) with Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server. Connection string uses a single database role 'app_user' with full SELECT on all tables. No row-level security policies are configured on the PostgreSQL instance despite the code comments suggesting otherwise. The application relies entirely on the EF Core WHERE clauses for tenant filtering. X-Query-Duration-Ms response header is exposed to clients. No API gateway or response header stripping is configured.

config.db_role: app_user (GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON ALL TABLES)
